request.text: A DLL was planted in Internet Explorer's folder on WORKSTATION6 from WORKSTATION5, and an IE started over DCOM spawned a notepad that is calling out. Contain host WORKSTATION6.theshire.local.

package.rationale: From WORKSTATION5, pgustavo wrote iertutil.dll into C:\Program Files\Internet Explorer on WORKSTATION6 over the C$ share; Internet Explorer then started over DCOM (-Embedding), loaded the planted DLL and spawned notepad.exe, which connects to 10.10.10.5:80. DCOM lateral movement with a DLL hijack delivered an implant; isolate WORKSTATION6.

permitted.note: rule A rule 2: WORKSTATION6.theshire.local is the request's host; policy P2-tier12-isolate; fulfils the request

rule A rule 2: iexplore.exe (PID 9428) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (the IE started over DCOM that loaded the planted iertutil.dll and spawned the implant); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)

rule A rule 2: notepad.exe (PID 3532) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (the implant, beaconing to 10.10.10.5:80); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)
rule A rule 2: pgustavo acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and ran the attack; policy P4-human-account; does not fulfil the request (side action)
